description: This is a Java interface defining the contract for a data service responsible for executing SQL queries, processing result sets, and providing utility methods related to database indexing and uniqueness checks within the Apache Fineract project.

methods.name: fillGenericResultSet
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result as a GenericResultsetData object.

methods.name: fillResultsetColumnHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves column header metadata for a given table name.

methods.name: fillResultsetRowData
methods.description: Fetches row data from the database based on the SQL query and column headers.

methods.name: generateJsonFromGenericResultsetData
methods.description: Converts a GenericResultsetData object into its JSON string representation.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs string replacement using the specified pattern and replacement string.

methods.name: wrapSQL
methods.description: Applies necessary wrapping or escaping to the provided SQL string.

methods.name: isExplicitlyUnique
methods.description: Checks if a specific column in a table has a uniqueness constraint.

methods.name: isExplicitlyIndexed
methods.description: Checks if a specific column in a table is indexed.
